docs\api.md:1:# API
docs\api.md:2:- POST /orders/{id}/cancel — returns 409 once the order has shipped; otherwise cancels it.
docs\api.md:3:- GET /orders?since=... — returns orders up to 7 years old.
docs\api.md:4:- Webhook `order.status_changed` fires on every status change.
docs\requirements.md:1:# Requirements
docs\requirements.md:2:- R1. An order can be cancelled at any time before it ships.
docs\requirements.md:3:- R2. Refunds are issued within 3 business days of cancellation.
docs\requirements.md:4:- R3. Customers must receive an email for every status change.
docs\requirements.md:5:- R4. Order history is kept for 7 years for audit.
docs\design.md:1:# Design
docs\design.md:2:- Cancellation is allowed only within 30 minutes of placing the order; after that the order is locked.
docs\design.md:3:- Refunds are batched and run every Friday.
docs\design.md:4:- Emails are sent only when the order ships or is delivered.
docs\design.md:5:- Orders older than 2 years are deleted by a nightly job to save storage.
src\orders.js:1:export function canCancel(order, now) {
src\orders.js:2:  return now - order.placedAt < 30 * 60 * 1000;
